definitions.gloss: to bend over; to stoop; to crouch
definitions.explanation: To bend one's body forward or downward, typically at the waist.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}を{屈|かが}めて{靴|くつ}を{履|は}く。
examples.english: To bend over and put on shoes.

examples.japanese: {低|ひく}い{入口|いりぐち}で{身|み}を{屈|かが}めた。
examples.english: I stooped at the low entrance.

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}を{屈|かが}めて{歩|ある}く{老人|ろうじん}。
examples.english: An elderly person walking with a stooped back.

notes:
{屈|かが}む describes bending or stooping the body, typically forward or downward. It focuses on the bending motion of the upper body or back.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- {屈|かが}む (dictionary form)
- {屈|かが}まない (negative)
- {屈|かが}んだ (past)
- {屈|かが}んで (te-form)

RELATED WORDS:
- {屈|かが}める (transitive): to bend (something)
- {前|まえ}{屈|かが}み: bending forward
